name: 접근 가능한 모든 테이블 조회
sql:
SELECT owner, table_name, tablespace_name, status
FROM all_tables
WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','OUTLN','DBSNMP')
ORDER BY owner, table_name

name: 접근 가능한 뷰 조회
sql:
SELECT owner, view_name, text 
FROM all_views 
WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','OUTLN','DBSNMP')
ORDER BY owner, view_name

name: 특정 테이블의 컬럼 정보 조회
sql:
SELECT column_name, data_type, data_length, nullable, data_default, column_id
FROM all_tab_columns
WHERE table_name = 'TABLE_NAME' AND owner = 'OWNER_NAME'
ORDER BY column_id

name: 내가 SELECT 권한을 가진 테이블 조회
sql:
SELECT owner, table_name
FROM all_tab_privs
WHERE privilege = 'SELECT' AND grantee = USER
ORDER BY owner, table_name

name: 특정 테이블의 인덱스 조회
sql:
SELECT index_name, index_type, uniqueness, status
FROM all_indexes
WHERE table_name = 'TABLE_NAME' AND owner = 'OWNER_NAME'
ORDER BY index_name

name: 특정 인덱스의 컬럼 조회
sql:
SELECT column_name, column_position, descend
FROM all_ind_columns
WHERE index_name = 'INDEX_NAME' AND index_owner = 'OWNER_NAME'
ORDER BY column_position

name: 특정 테이블의 제약조건 조회
sql:
SELECT constraint_name, constraint_type, status, validated, search_condition
FROM all_constraints
WHERE table_name = 'TABLE_NAME' AND owner = 'OWNER_NAME'
ORDER BY constraint_name

name: 현재 접속한 사용자 정보
sql:
SELECT user, sys_context('USERENV', 'SESSION_USER') as session_user,
       sys_context('USERENV', 'CURRENT_SCHEMA') as current_schema
FROM dual

name: 모든 스키마의 테이블 개수 통계
sql:
SELECT owner, COUNT(*) as table_count
FROM all_tables
WHERE owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','OUTLN','DBSNMP')
GROUP BY owner
ORDER BY table_count DESC

name: 접근 가능한 테이블/뷰의 모든 컬럼 정보
sql:
SELECT owner, table_name, column_name, data_type, data_length, nullable
FROM all_tab_columns
WHERE owner IN (
  SELECT DISTINCT owner 
  FROM all_tab_privs
  WHERE privilege = 'SELECT' AND grantee = USER
)
ORDER BY owner, table_name, column_id

name: 특정 키워드가 포함된 컬럼 찾기
sql:
SELECT owner, table_name, column_name, data_type, data_length
FROM all_tab_columns
WHERE UPPER(column_name) LIKE '%KEYWORD%'
AND owner NOT IN ('SYS','SYSTEM','OUTLN','DBSNMP')
ORDER BY owner, table_name, column_name
